style.backgroundSystem: two linked screen systems held to one material language: a faceted rose studio build (broad gradient wall falling from #C4716E at the lower left to #F7D3D0 at the upper right, two large translucent acrylic planes in #DE9A95 tilted on either side, one cylindrical rose podium, faint diagonal light streaks across the wall) for the opening, combination and closing screens; flat #FFFFFF or #F7D3D0 infographic screens carrying rounded cards with 20px corners, each card closed by a solid rose label band in #DE9A95, for every copy-led screen; never a third background language and never a scenic outdoor backdrop
style.direction: blush-rose faceted studio pet-nutrition detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: single-family components drawn only in the rose palette: solid capsule bars in #DE9A95 carrying #FFFFFF labels, rounded image cards closed by a solid rose band, one hairline dotted semicircle tick arc with no numerals, oversized open quotation glyphs in #F7D3D0, dashed hairline dividers in #FFFFFF; no medical crosses, no organ or gut diagrams, no microbe illustrations, no gold ornate certificate frames, no seals, medals, ribbons or shield badges
style.lightingSystem: bright soft 5500K studio key from the upper left with a large bounce fill, light glowing through the translucent rose planes, low-contrast gradient falloff, matte non-specular carton surfaces with one controlled soft highlight along the box shoulder, soft contact shadows only so nothing floats; the single home feeding scene uses natural window light from the left at 5200K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent blush-rose faceted-studio pet-nutrition ecommerce visual system across the entire detail-page image set; fixed palette of clean field #FFFFFF, pale blush panel #F7D3D0, rose coral stage #DE9A95 and deep rose backdrop #C4716E, with text #2D2D2D, one neutral grey comparison tone #BFBFBF and one emphasis #D2495A; warm temperature; modern geometric sans-serif Chinese typography, one family and one headline weight per screen, with a letter-spaced latin kicker above each headline and solid capsule sub-badges; background system alternating a faceted rose studio build (gradient wall falling from #C4716E at the lower left to #F7D3D0 at the upper right, two translucent acrylic planes in #DE9A95, one cylindrical rose podium, faint diagonal light streaks) and flat #FFFFFF or #F7D3D0 infographic screens carrying rounded cards with 20px corners closed by a solid rose label band in #DE9A95; bright soft 5500K key from the upper left with a large bounce fill, glow through the translucent planes, matte non-specular surfaces, soft contact shadows only, and natural window light at 5200K in the single home feeding scene; matte rose podium #DE9A95 and shelf #C4716E surfaces, pale #F7D3D0 card and counter surfaces; single-family rose infographic components of capsule bars, card grids with solid label bands, one dotted semicircle tick arc without numerals, oversized quotation glyphs and dashed hairline dividers; the upright white carton held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and scale with its folds, seams and printed panel true to the reference, stick sachets always the same slim crimped rectangle, the pet always cropped or turned away and never clothed; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no source brand or watermark text, no QR code, no certificate frames or seals, no medical iconography, no numerals presented as measurements, no glossy hyper-real plastic render drift.
noDrift: no brand, agency or watermark text carried over from the source template
no QR codes, membership stickers or store badges
no gold certificate frames, diploma artwork, seals or medals
no medical or veterinary iconography such as crosses, pills-and-syringe, organ or microbe graphics
no numerals presented as measurements, counts, durations, rates or test results
no glossy hyper-real plastic render drift
style.presentationRules: the upright white carton is held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and the same scale on every screen, grounded by a soft contact shadow on the rose podium, its edge folds, corner seams and flat printed panel true to the reference and never restyled; every stick sachet reads as the same slim rectangle with the same twin crimped ends; the pet companion is always cropped at a frame edge or turned away so no individual animal identity dominates, and never wears clothing; card corners fixed at 20px radius
style.surfaceSystem: matte rose cylinder podium #DE9A95 with rose shelf planes #C4716E inside the studio screens, matte #FFFFFF and #F7D3D0 card surfaces inside the infographic screens, one pale matte home counter in #F7D3D0 with a glossy ceramic bowl #FFFFFF in the single feeding scene
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif Chinese, one family only, one headline weight per screen; a letter-spaced latin kicker line sits above each Chinese headline; Chinese headline 30-44pt in #FFFFFF on rose fields and in #2D2D2D on light fields with at most one word emphasised in #D2495A, solid capsule sub-badge 14-18pt in #FFFFFF on #DE9A95, card-band caption 16-18pt, spec-row label 14-16pt; every rendered line is carried as a 「」 placeholder, never as source copy
